scope: Read-only inspection of public upstream repository, release metadata, documentation and source. No model or application was downloaded or executed.

main_finding.conclusion: The public Android implementation has author-reported inference on Snapdragon 8 Elite / SM8750 / Hexagon v79, including small visual cases. It is a credible separate large-MoE research candidate, not evidence that Hepta phone control, production-domain NPU access or this handset has passed.
confidence_boundaries: Source and release metadata were retrieved; no downloaded APK bytes were independently hashed.
The 19.315 GB bundle is referenced by source, but its remote SHA256SUMS and expert manifest were not retrieved.
No accuracy, speed, memory or reliability result here was measured on the user's razr.

main_after_release.changed_scope: Qwen3-VL path in llama_jni.cpp: v75 tight mapping layout and image-prefill context reclamation.
main_after_release.v79_statement: PR states the existing SM8750/v79 behavior is unchanged.
main_after_release.limits: The v75 path uses CPU vision, smaller context/batch and discards older conversation KV before image turns. This PR does not establish stable multi-turn MiniCPM MoE on v79.

platform_and_execution.authors_validated_platform: OnePlus 13 / PJZ110, Snapdragon 8 Elite / SM8750, Hexagon v79
platform_and_execution.authors_other_platform: The v0.4.1 release separately reports MOSS-Image generation on SM8750/v79 and SM8850/v81; those are image-generation tests, not GUI-agent tests.
platform_and_execution.current_runtime_target: HTP0, and HTP1 when detected; layer split; n_gpu_layers=99; draft assigned to the same devices.
platform_and_execution.fully_on_device_interpretation: Local target/draft inference and local weight I/O; it does not mean every operator executes on the NPU.
platform_and_execution.cpu_fallback: DEPLOY explicitly identifies visual UPSCALE/position interpolation as expected CPU fallback. Host scheduling, sampling and flash I/O also remain host work.
platform_and_execution.app_integration: CMake links an in-process server-context/queue core; app benchmark documentation says it launches neither an external llama-cli process nor an HTTP listener.
platform_and_execution.app_driver_declaration: AndroidManifest.xml declares libcdsprpc.so as an optional native library; this is not proof that Hepta's custom UID/domain has equivalent FastRPC access.

author_measurements.attribution: All following measurements are author reports from the cited fixed source, not results from the user's handset.

readme_text_table.limitation: This text-only table is not image-to-action latency, cold-load latency or a like-for-like comparison to the existing QAIRT acceptance runs.

app_six_cases.image_fixture: Same 224x224 image containing a red square on the left and a blue circle on the right.
app_six_cases.task_scope: Short English explanation and simple two-shape visual description; no phone screenshot, GUI coordinate, action schema or App control.
app_six_cases.authors_semantic_observation: All three image responses identify the two shapes and their colors correctly.
limitations: One observation per case, each after an app restart; system file caches were retained.
Image output lengths differ (108 versus 128), so total response time is not a fixed-work speed comparison.
Image response wording changes between configurations; the authors explicitly say this is not proof of exact greedy equivalence or broad quality.
An earlier continuous run completed two text requests; the third lacked an app completion record and coincided with DSP queue errors. Restarted-case successes do not resolve that reliability issue.

observations: A 512-input/128-output prefetch sweep reports 12 successful runs with identical output SHA256 a987367b2f85ca33bb2469cf9966c0320b223b0a89f8d747d2a432d06d3671f0, but this compares prefetch settings, not an unquantized reference.
The documentation reports differing performance across earlier and later sweeps and does not isolate the cause.
Logical expert-read volume is explicitly not physical UFS traffic; a six-GB process ceiling was not established.
The fastest CLI reproduction combined app core libraries with older CLI glue and an added libc++ runtime, so it is not identical to the Java/JNI app process.

source_observations: moe_k_prefill and moe_k_decode default to zero; the inspected MiniCPM runtime does not set an explicit reduced-expert override.
The context initially sets n_expert_used to zero; its effective getter returns the model's own hparams value in that case.
The graph retains hparams.n_expert_used unless a positive override is explicitly configured; the router selects its top-k using that effective value.
The packaging guide describes preserving original eight-expert routing metadata.
default_router.conclusion: Default source behavior preserves the model's original routing rather than implicitly capping it to four experts; the guide describes eight routed experts.
default_router.limitation: The actual remote GGUF/expert manifest was not fetched, so eight is not an independently verified field from the distributed bundle.

les.mechanism: Cross-layer prediction supplies prefetch/scheduling hints. Actual router-selected experts still determine computation; misses are loaded and evaluated.
les.upstream_measurement: The technical note's 17.39 token/s and broad benchmark discussion are for iPad Pro 11-inch M4 (16 GB), not the Android v79 package.

target_verification.observed_path: server-context invokes common_sampler_sample_and_accept_n on target-model logits. That helper samples a target token at each speculative position, compares it to the draft token and stops at the first mismatch, with a target bonus token after complete acceptance. The server has checkpoint/rollback handling.
target_verification.conclusion: There is an actual target-verification path, rather than accepting draft tokens solely because a confidence head predicts acceptance.
not_proven: End-to-end numerical equivalence of the quantized Android target/draft and state restoration.
Broad quality retention for the Hexagon tiled bundle.
Reliable repeated visual turns, schema-constrained Hepta actions or phone control.

defaults_and_documentation_drift.source_calibration_caveat: Memory header states its existing calibration used eager vision plus Q8 draft length one; the draft-three default has not been remeasured against that calibration.
documentation_differences: DEPLOY describes context 2048 and batch/ubatch 128; these are historical documented/test conditions, not proof of the current constructor and memory defaults.
DEPLOY says roughly 17 GB, while README says roughly 19 GB and the fixed Kotlin catalogue declares 19,315,173,512 bytes.
Default prefetch zero disables lookahead prefetch specifically; it does not disable external expert storage, tiled layout or the residency/cache mechanism.
Runtime source can disable speculation when a draft is absent or reload without it after a failed speculative load. A configured/default flag alone is not proof that a request used DSpark.

documented_components: minicpm47-les-hexagon.gguf (resident tensors, routed expert payload stripped)
bundle.this_review_metadata_retrieval: Web retrieval of the ModelScope page, SHA256SUMS and expert manifest reported inaccessible URLs. No full bundle or metadata success is claimed.
bundle.downloader_source: LlamaEngine builds the ModelScope resolve/master base, reads the checksum manifest, then downloads and hashes each listed relative path.
bundle.packaging: tools/moe/HEXAGON.md supports Q3_K, Q4_K and Q6_K expert tensors, including different types across layers. Tiled output needs a matching backend revision and matching stripped resident model. Raw extraction verification does not by itself verify the converted tiled bytes.

literature_and_scope.finding: The repository provides implementation, engineering notes and related-paper surveys. No standalone MobiInfer Android paper was identified in the inspected primary materials and bounded searches.
literature_and_scope.hepta_integration: The current Hepta QAIRT profile uses a specific compiled Qwen3-VL-4B model context. A separate llama.cpp-derived external-expert runtime and its complete ABI/asset/protocol qualification would be needed; this is not a model-file substitution.
literature_and_scope.next_decision: Retain as a separately pinned v79 MoE research candidate. Obtain the small immutable bundle inventory before considering any weight transfer; keep the existing qualified model/runtime decisions distinct.
